brief: A pichhoda-inspired dot field: yellow ground, maroon dots of radius 3 on a staggered lattice with pairwise clearance >= 4 px, C4 symmetry of the dot set about the tile centre, a central dot-free disc of radius 10, and a ring of 12 smaller dots (radius 1) around that disc.
